LanguageData.RT_T28_Vehicle.label: T-28 Medium Tank
LanguageData.RT_T28_Vehicle.description:
Multi-turreted Soviet medium infantry support tank armed with a 76.2mm KT-28 short gun and 3 machine guns.
<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Commander x1, Gunner x1, Machine Gunners x2 <color=#bb8f04>Fuel:</color> Chemfuel
<color=#b0e0e6>CE Ammo:</color> - 76.2mm KT-28 Gun: 76.2x385mmR (APHE / HE / Shrapnel) - 3x 7.62mm DT MG: 7.62x54mmR cartridge (FMJ / AP / HP)
